Fragrance Revival offers a recreation/'type' version of Bouquet Imperial, a common signal that the original is genuinely out of production and being replicated for fans.

marketCheck.note: No longer sold by Roger & Gallet or mainstream retailers; available only via eBay (explicitly marketed as discontinued stock) and through recreation/inspired-by services like Fragrance Revival.
